properties.name: app.enquiry-token-validity-hours
properties.description: Hours an enquiry-form link stays valid.

properties.name: app.pdf-storage-dir
properties.description: Directory where generated quotation PDFs are stored.

properties.name: app.quotation-validity-days
properties.description: Days a quotation acceptance link / quotation itself stays valid.

properties.name: company.api-base-url
properties.description: Public HTTPS URL of the deployed BACKEND (Spring Boot), e.g. https://crm-backend-production-7244.up.railway.app. Used for links that must be served by the backend itself - most importantly the quotation PDF that WhatsApp downloads. If this pointed at the frontend, the SPA rewrite would return index.html and WhatsApp would deliver the file as "SE-xxxx-2026.pdf.html".

properties.name: company.public-base-url
properties.description: Public base URL of the deployed frontend, e.g. https://yourdomain.com

properties.name: pricing.default-additional-charges
properties.description: Flat additional charges applied to every quotation (installation, logistics, etc.)

properties.name: pricing.default-discount-percentage
properties.description: Default discount percentage (0-100) applied unless overridden per-quotation.

properties.name: pricing.default-tax-percentage
properties.description: Default tax percentage (e.g. GST 18).

properties.name: pricing.rate-per-square-foot
properties.description: Default rate per square foot, used when the enquiry doesn't specify explicit line items.

properties.name: whatsapp.access-token
properties.description: WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN

properties.name: whatsapp.api-version
properties.description: WHATSAPP_API_VERSION, e.g. v20.0

properties.name: whatsapp.business-account-id
properties.description: WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID

properties.name: whatsapp.confirm-template-name
properties.description: Sent the moment a new lead comes in: welcome + link to the enquiry form. (WHATSAPP_CONFIRM_TEMPLATE_NAME)

properties.name: whatsapp.customer-template-name
properties.description: Sent when an admin replies to a customer's "request changes" note. (WHATSAPP_CUSTOMER_TEMPLATE_NAME)

properties.name: whatsapp.enquiry-template-name
properties.description: Sent once the customer has filled the enquiry form and the quotation is ready. (WHATSAPP_ENQUIRY_TEMPLATE_NAME)

properties.name: whatsapp.header-image-url
properties.description: Public HTTPS URL of the image used in the IMAGE header of the templates below (WHATSAPP_HEADER_IMAGE_URL). Must be JPG/PNG, under 5 MB, reachable without login. Falls back to the older WHATSAPP_ENQUIRY_HEADER_IMAGE_URL if only that one is set.

properties.name: whatsapp.image-header-templates
properties.description: Comma-separated template names that were approved with an image header/media sample (WHATSAPP_IMAGE_HEADER_TEMPLATES). Remove a name if that template has NO header - sending a header to a template without one fails with a parameter-mismatch error.

properties.name: whatsapp.order-template-name
properties.description: Sent once the customer accepts a quotation. (WHATSAPP_ORDER_TEMPLATE_NAME)

properties.name: whatsapp.phone-number-id
properties.description: WHATSAPP_PHONE_NUMBER_ID

properties.name: whatsapp.template-language
properties.description: Language code the templates were approved under in WhatsApp Manager (WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE_LANGUAGE). This must be the exact code Meta shows next to the template, e.g. "en", "en_US" or "en_GB" - "ENG" is not a valid Graph API code by itself. Sending the wrong code is the #1 reason a template send fails with error 132001 ("template name does not exist in the translation").

properties.name: whatsapp.webhook-verify-token
properties.description: Shared secret used to validate incoming webhook verify requests (WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN)
